purpose: Validate readiness for future Student→Attempt→Question→Challenge→Certification History→Resolution workflow. Confirm the artifact-side contract (S202.1 Investigation Linkage) is complete and that the S204 Admin Pilot revealed no blockers.

workflow_steps.action: Attempts a question in a practice session
workflow_steps.artifact_support: Exam session recorded in session registry. Question QID + session ID linked by session_linker.js (S322 Script 6).

workflow_steps.action: Flags a question for review / challenge
workflow_steps.artifact_support: Challenge record created: Student ID + QID + Session ID + Challenge Reason. Linked to Certification Scan Artifact via QID + scan timestamp.

workflow_steps.action: Reviews challenge — queries Certification Scan Artifact for the item's scan history
workflow_steps.artifact_support: S202.1 Investigation Linkage: 7 IQ queries (IQ-001 through IQ-007) support challenge investigation. IQ-001: Item identity verification. IQ-002: Defect history lookup. IQ-003: Scan history timeline. IQ-004: Readiness classification history. IQ-005: Recommendation linkage. IQ-006: Certification history. IQ-007: Cross-session delta tracking.

workflow_steps.action: Resolves challenge — may create a recommendation (REC-ID) if defect confirmed
workflow_steps.artifact_support: Recommendation pipeline (S322 Script 5): REC-ID created from challenge. Session assigned. Closure tracked in RECOMMENDATION_REGISTRY.json.
Certification Scan Artifact lineage (section 7) records the scan that confirmed the fix. Delta ledger records the content hash change from pre-fix to post-fix.

investigation_workflow_contract.artifact_contract_status: COMPLETE — S202.1 Investigation Linkage (SESSION2021_INVESTIGATION_LINKAGE.json) defines all 7 IQ queries and 5 escalation paths. The artifact schema supports every workflow step without modification.

query_details.IQ-001_identity_verification: Resolved from artifact section 4 (perItemResults) — item identity, QID, pack, compound key
query_details.IQ-002_defect_history: Resolved from artifact section 5 (defectInventory) — historical defect flags per item
query_details.IQ-003_scan_timeline: Resolved from artifact sections 1 (scanContext) + 7 (lineage) — scan timestamp, version chain
query_details.IQ-004_readiness_history: Resolved from artifact section 6 (readiness) — readiness classification timeline
query_details.IQ-005_recommendation_linkage: Resolved from RECOMMENDATION_REGISTRY.json — REC-ID linked to QID via compound key
query_details.IQ-006_certification_history: Resolved from artifact section 7 (lineage) + question_state field — certification state over time
query_details.IQ-007_delta_tracking: Resolved from DELTA_LEDGER.json + artifact section 2 (packFileHashes) — content hash changes between scans

paths.EP-001_confirmed_defect: Challenge → REC-ID created → Assigned to remediation session → Closure tracked → Re-scan confirms fix
paths.EP-002_student_misunderstanding: Challenge → Admin reviews scan artifact (item is READY, no defects) → Response to student with educational explanation
paths.EP-003_known_defect_already_tracked: Challenge → IQ-002 finds existing REC-ID → Admin links challenge to existing recommendation → No duplicate REC-ID created (S809 prevention)
paths.EP-004_content_dispute: Challenge → Admin escalates to Certification Board → Board reviews six-dimension verification → Decision logged in artifact governanceAttestation
paths.EP-005_system_anomaly: Challenge → IQ-007 delta tracking reveals unexpected content change → Escalated to Governance Board → G1-G5 reconciliation runbook
